stem.en: Two children of different masses sit on identical swings. You want to give both swings the same acceleration at the start. Which child needs the larger force?

feedback.en: For the same acceleration, F = ma is smaller for the smaller mass.
The swings are identical, but the children are not. The larger mass needs a larger force.
Right. From F = ma, the same acceleration needs a larger force for a larger mass.

explanation.en: From F = ma, for the same acceleration a, the force is proportional to the mass. The heavier child needs the larger force.

hints.en: Use F = ma with the same a for both.
